flagged.title: Anglo-Saxon Resistance & the Harrying of the North
flagged.reason: At 00:08, the video incorrectly states that William won at Stamford Bridge, which is a significant factual error on an examined GCSE specification topic that would lose marks in an exam.

mark_affecting.video_says: We've talked about William winning at Stamford Bridge and Hastings
mark_affecting.lesson_says: The lesson identifies Hastings as William's victory ('the most serious threat William had faced since Hastings'); Stamford Bridge was fought and won by King Harold Godwinson against Harald Hardrada, not William.
